# v2.4.0

This release makes Gemini 4 Carbon the default model for analysis and brainstorming.

## Changes

- `ask-gemini` and `brainstorm` default to `Gemini 4 Carbon (High)`. `Gemini 4 Carbon (Low)` and `(Medium)` are available as explicit overrides.
- Every Gemini 4 Argon tier stays supported: pass `model: "Gemini 4 Argon (High)"` (or Low/Medium) to keep using it. The server does not fall back automatically when the default is unavailable.
- `live-pass` and `screen-review` still default to `Gemini 3.8 Flash (Medium)`.
- Google currently lists Carbon in Antigravity for Google AI Ultra and Enterprise accounts; check `agy models` (verified with agy 1.5.5).

Install with `npm install -g @joeytheman/gemini-mcp-tool@2.4.0`, or run it with `npx -y @joeytheman/gemini-mcp-tool@2.4.0`.
